name: io.github.NeoDrew/chromeflow
description: Chrome extension + MCP server. Lets coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI) drive your real Chrome — sessions intact, cookies preserved, 2FA stays with the user. 26 browser tools including privileged fetch that bypasses page CSP, authenticated downloads, in-extension docx parsing, multi-session support. Battle-tested by 400+ hours of real agentic browser work before public release.
